text:
Anya Patel: Quick sync — Acme wants to add 12 seats mid-term and move to an early renewal (12mo) to lock pricing. Procurement is asking for a PO by 2026-03-24. Need confirmation on the 10% early-renewal credit and whether we can accept a PO instead of DocuSign. @Mike Chen can you confirm discount and quote number? @Elaine Torres any legal flags on an amendment?

Mike Chen: Confirmed — we can offer 10% off the recurring MRR pro-rated for the remaining term as an early-renewal credit if they commit to a 12mo renewal. Quote number R-4521. I'll push the updated quote to Jared.

Khalid Rahman: If PO arrives, infra can provision the 12 seats in ~48h but we need billing change/PO# before provisioning. Who's the billing contact?

Anya Patel: Buyer is Jared @ Acme (procurement). I'll CC billing@acme on the invoice. Jared asked if we accept PO or only e-sign.

Elaine Torres: Legal ok with PO acceptance under standard T&Cs. If they submit PO with redlines we need 3–5 business days to review. For early renewals we'll require a 1-paragraph amendment that sets the new term dates and ties the credit to the signed PO date. I'll draft the addendum.

Mike Chen: Two execution options: 1) DocuSign amendment + e-sign (fast) 2) PO + countersigned amendment (slower). Jared prefers PO. Any objections to proceeding on PO terms?

Anya Patel: No objections from CS. We should make the discount contingent on the PO date (not invoice date) per procurement request.

Khalid Rahman: Billing note — we need PO# on the invoice. We can do Net 30 if they request, but PO number must be present.

Mike Chen: Uploading quote snippet now:
```
Quote: R-4521
12-seat add-on
Net new MRR: $3,600
Early renewal credit (10%): -$360 one-time
Total first invoice: $3,240
Payment terms: Net 30 or PO
```
I'll send to Jared and loop legal.

Anya Patel: @Mike ping me when sent and include the amendment timeline. I'll nudge procurement. Also request that the amendment sets renewal to end-of-current-term + 12 months.

Mike Chen: Sent to Jared, cc Anya & Elaine. Jared replied "PO in progress, expect by 2026-03-24." :thumbsup:

Elaine Torres: Drafted amendment (amendment_acme_0319.docx) and uploaded to the shared drive. No substantial redlines. If they only provide a PO, we will need a signed amendment within 7 days to honor the credit.

Anya Patel: Action items: Mike — confirm invoice terms and send quote (done). Elaine — finalize amendment (done). Khalid — prep provisioning playbook and standby. I'll follow up 2026-03-24 if PO not received.

Khalid Rahman: Provisioning playbook snippet: `team:add-seats acme 12 --deploy` then verify seat assignment and monitor quotas. ETA ~48h after billing confirmation.

Mike Chen: Customer replied: "We will route PO today, please proceed with provisioning upon invoice receipt." I'll update thread when PO is in.

Anya Patel: Thanks team — marking as high priority. I'll log the renewal risk as low now that PO is in flight.
